# The Roadside Diner

> American roadside diner in Lebanon (burgers, fried chicken, loaded fries, shakes) with 3 branches around Beirut, delivery, pickup and the Roadside ordering app.

## Branches
- [Karout Mall, Al Hadath](https://roadsidediner.app/locations/karout-mall-hadath/): open daily 11:00–22:00, phone +961 71 53 57 57, coordinates 33.85597,35.52684
- [Centro Mall, Jnah](https://roadsidediner.app/locations/centro-mall-jnah/): open daily 11:00–22:00, phone +961 81 53 57 57, coordinates 33.86051,35.49009
- [The Town Village, Mansourieh](https://roadsidediner.app/locations/town-village-mansourieh/): open daily 12:00–23:30, phone +961 76 53 57 57, coordinates 33.85439,35.56975

## Facts
- Payment: cash on delivery or pickup (online payment coming soon).
- Prices in US dollars; some items vary by branch.
- Contact: theroadsidebeirut@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/theroadsidediner.leb/
